title: Symmetries Listed
description: Essential Criteria: The student must list all relevant symmetries of the Schrödinger equation.

title: Constants of Motion
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify all constants of motion associated with the system.

title: Ground-State Wave Function
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct form of the ground-state wave function.

title: Correct Form of r
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly define the relative position vector r = r1 - r2.

title: Center of Mass Motion
description: Important Criteria: The student must recognize the separation of motion into center of mass and relative coordinates.

title: Gaussian Form
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention that the ground-state wave function is Gaussian in form.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid unit mistakes when discussing physical quantities.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the expressions for energy and momentum.
